title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-28 09:56:18 最新章节：第1038章 天龟肆虐
slug: 聚宝仙锅第1038章天龟肆虐
content_zh:
寒天大陆。
天贵城，这是一个以修士为主导的城市。
在西城区一条大街上，李凡正在推着一辆小车，顶着凛冽的寒风，艰难的行走，可是口中还得尽力的大喊，“收各种残破废弃的法器，符咒，还有炼器材料喽。”
不错，李凡干的是修仙界收废品的行当。
回想当初，自己检测出灵根，整个李家村一片欢腾。
各家各户，张灯结彩，鞭炮齐鸣，给李凡送行。
在无数期待的目光中，李凡踏上自己的修仙之路。
可是，自己来到青云门修仙门派，进行精确的灵根测试，却悲催的发现，自己是修仙界最垃圾的五灵根。
五灵根，通常叫做杂灵根，废灵根，甚至和凡人无异。
这种资质，即使是门派的外门弟子，都不配当。
大起大落！
李凡幼小的心灵，遭受一次沉重的打击。
被扫地出门的李凡，不甘心回家当一个农民，也没有脸面再回去。
几经周折，李凡才来到天贵城这个修仙界城市。
可是，一个杂灵根在这么一个处处都需要灵石的修仙城市，如何生存！
没有一技之长的李凡，最后开始这种收破烂的行当。
这一下来，就是五年的时光。
说回正题。
看天色暗下来，李凡这才推着小车，打道回府。
今天，只收获一口看着十分普通的大铁锅。

聊胜于无！
凛冽的寒风，吹透李凡破烂不堪的小棉袄，脚上的草鞋也随时都要彻底稀巴烂。
这几年里，李凡省吃俭用，攒下的灵石都用来修炼。
可是，无论自己怎么努力，修为一直停在炼气二层，无法再有突破。
寒冬腊月，李凡迎着寒风，快步行走。
自从得到大铁锅，李凡总有一种奇怪的感觉。
这不，快速行走的李凡，不踏实的看一眼大铁锅，却感觉嗡的一下，如同被人敲了一下闷棍。
眩晕！
一个不小心，李凡摔倒在地，倒霉的他嘴角竟然磕在大铁锅的锅沿上。
一滴鲜血，粘到锅沿，却神奇的被大铁锅直接吸收。
嗡！
与此同时，李凡感觉脑袋一阵天旋地转。
脑海里闪过一个宏伟的画面。
自己站在苍穹之上，俯视三界万物。
而无数千奇百怪的物种，都臣服在自己的脚下。
感觉自己，是这个宇宙的主宰！
这种睥睨天下的感觉，一闪而逝。
“难道自己摔迷糊了？”
content_en:
Hantian Continent.
Tiangui City is a city dominated by monks.
On a street in Xicheng District, Li Fan was pushing a small cart, walking hard against the biting cold wind, but he still had to shout as loud as he could, "Collect all kinds of broken and discarded magic weapons, charms, and weapon refining materials."
Yes, Li Fan is in the business of collecting scraps in the world of immortality.
Looking back on the time when I detected my spiritual root, the entire Lijia Village was filled with joy.
Every household decorated with lanterns and colorful firecrackers to see Li Fan off.
Amid countless expectant eyes, Li Fan embarked on his own path of cultivating immortality.
However, when he came to the Qingyun Sect to conduct an accurate spiritual root test, he sadly discovered that he had the most rubbish five spiritual roots in the world of immortality.
The five spiritual roots are usually called miscellaneous spiritual roots and waste spiritual roots, and they are even the same as ordinary people.
Even the outer disciples of the sect are not worthy of this kind of qualification.
Big ups and downs!
Li Fan's young mind suffered a heavy blow.
Li Fan, who was kicked out, was unwilling to go home and be a farmer, and he had no shame to go back.
After many twists and turns, Li Fan came to Tiangui City, a city in the world of immortality.
However, how can a miscellaneous spiritual root survive in such a city where spiritual stones are needed everywhere!
Li Fan, who had no skills, finally started the rag collecting business.
This time, it will be five years.
Back to the topic.
Seeing that the sky was getting dark, Li Fan pushed the car and headed back home.
Today, I only got a large iron pot that looked very ordinary.
Better than nothing!
The biting cold wind blew through Li Fan's tattered cotton-padded jacket, and the straw sandals on his feet were about to be completely torn to pieces at any time.
In the past few years, Li Fan had been frugal and used all the spiritual stones he saved to practice.
However, no matter how hard I try, my cultivation has been stuck at the second level of Qi Refining, and I can no longer make a breakthrough.
In the cold winter, Li Fan walked quickly against the cold wind.
Ever since he got the big iron pot, Li Fan always had a strange feeling.
No, Li Fan, who was walking quickly, glanced at the big iron pot and felt a buzz, as if someone had knocked a sap.
dizziness!
By accident, Li Fan fell to the ground, and unfortunately he hit the edge of the large iron pot with the corner of his mouth.
A drop of blood stuck to the edge of the pot, but was miraculously absorbed directly by the big iron pot.
Buzz!
At the same time, Li Fan felt his head spinning.
A grand picture flashed through my mind.
Standing on the sky, looking down at all things in the three realms.
And countless strange species all surrendered under his feet.
I feel like I am the master of this universe!
This feeling of looking down on the world disappeared in a flash.
"Did you fall into confusion?"
